facts.text: The WVU Guarantee is open to West Virginia resident undergraduates across the WVU System who have a family adjusted gross income of $65,000 or less and complete the FAFSA.

sources.title: WVU Guarantee | WVU Hub | West Virginia University
sources.quote: WVU Guarantee is open to undergraduate students across the WVU System who are West Virginia residents, have a family Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) of $65,000 or less and annually complete the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA).
